mapper.insert: INSERT INTO member ( member_num, member_email, member_pwd, member_name, member_nick, member_phone, authority, regdate, member_code, point, member_login_type, member_social_id ) VALUES ( member_seq.NEXTVAL, #{member_email, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{member_pwd, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{member_name, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{member_nick, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{member_phone, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, #{authority, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, SYSDATE, #{member_code, jdbcType=VARCHAR}, 0, 'LOCAL', #{member_social_id, jdbcType=VARCHAR} )
mapper.select: SELECT member_num, member_email, member_pwd, member_name, member_nick, member_phone, authority, regdate, member_code, point, member_login_type, member_social_id FROM member WHERE member_email = #{email}
